title: AuditRequest
description: A request to audit one page of a load's documents.

doc_ids.description:
The documents audited, up to 1,000 ids, each once: a page of the load's documents with
reviews. An id the load doesn't hold is skipped. None only with `rows`.

helix.description: Where the graph is read: the backend's read-only proxy.

mappings_toml.description:
The load's version's `mappings.toml`, whose routes say what each document set's
documents may state.

ontology_toml.description: The load's version's `ontology.toml`, which types what it holds.

ontology_version.description: The version the load records; a load of another version is `load_mismatch`.

request_id.description: The idempotency key; an audit writes nothing, so a retry simply reads again.

rows.description:
What the load's ingest report gave of its rows' errors, and its sources' drift, to audit
once a run: send it with one call (the first page's, or alone), so each row finding is
counted once. Without it the row kinds go unmeasured (`rows: unmeasured`), as for a load
whose report keeps no row errors.

HelixTarget.description: Where the graph is written: the backend's proxy for one Helix database.

max_request_bytes.description: The largest request body the proxy takes; a write past it is refused before it is sent.

timeout_secs.description: How long one request may take, in seconds.

token.description: The job's bearer token for the proxy.

LoadId.description: One load of an approved version into a graph: the id of the backend job that creates it, such as a ULID. One or more printable ASCII characters, no space.

MappingDrift.description: How one mapping's source changed since the load's version was written, as Foundry saw it.

mapping.description: The mapping, as the load's version names it.

MappingErrors.description:
One mapping's row errors, as the load's ingest report gave them (its `row_errors`): how
many, and some of their texts.

count.description: Rows, or parts of rows, that compiled to nothing.

examples.description: Some of their texts, no more than `count`.

mapping.description: The mapping, as the load's version names it.

RowsReported.description:
What the caller sends of a load's rows: its ingest report's row errors and its sources'
drift. A load whose report keeps no row errors (one an older version wrote) has none to
send, and its row kinds go unmeasured.
